goal: Customer-ready Part A brand investigation product

items.criterion: A separately authorized customer can sign in and access only their study.
items.dependency: The Site remains owner-private; no intended pilot identity/audience is specified.
items.nextAction: Configure the named pilot audience through Sites and verify owner/editor/viewer separation in a second real session.

items.criterion: A real brand study collects actual answers through each API advertised as live.
items.dependency: Provider credentials and per-account model/search compatibility have not been supplied or verified.
items.nextAction: Use secure Connections; record the real model, search mode, prompt, timestamps, answer, usage and disclosed citations. Mark unvalidated adapters honestly.

items.criterion: A real consumer-app answer is captured/imported with its known conditions and original evidence.
items.dependency: No real signed-in consumer capture session has been exercised.
items.nextAction: Exercise the existing capture/import flow against a real account; confirm its consumer label, exact text, links and screenshot.

items.criterion: A disclosed public URL is retrieved successfully and its exact excerpt remains linked after recapture.
items.dependency: The real build-environment attempt failed on DNS resolution; only fixtures establish successful retrieval.
items.nextAction: Try a supported disclosed URL from the deployed app and preserve a redacted successful capture/review/recapture receipt.

items.criterion: A real client completes the answer-to-source-to-finding-to-challenge/report workflow.
items.dependency: No separate real-client end-to-end study has been performed.
items.nextAction: Run the complete customer journey with real evidence, export/open the dated report and resolve one finding challenge.

items.criterion: Advertised unattended monitoring completes a real scheduled job without duplicate execution.
items.dependency: No QStash account; the current outer private gate blocks external callbacks.
items.nextAction: Configure an authorized reachable callback and account without bypassing authentication; verify schedule, failure, pause and duplicate delivery.

items.criterion: Advertised report emails reach an authorized test recipient with recorded delivery status.
items.dependency: No Resend connection, verified sender or selected real recipient is available.
items.nextAction: Configure the intended sender/recipient and verify one real delivery and safe retry; never send to invented recipients.
